intended_distribution_profile: A provenance-complete Manitoba 2026 field-scouting supplement. It preserves current, province-specific monitoring and decision-threshold evidence while excluding pesticide product tables, rates, logos, and unreviewed third-party material. A threshold is not product authorization; current PMRA labels remain authoritative for any pesticide action.
